evidence_checks.claim: Brew ratio is derived from measured dose and output. TDS, EY and subjective quality are distinct; time often reflects coupled hydraulic outcome rather than an independent quality target.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js baseline and nextAdvice treat measured time as feedback, not standalone taste success

evidence_checks.source: PDF-SLOW-FEED pp1-10; Kaffeemacher 2025 original study; Smrke et al Scientific Reports 2024
evidence_checks.claim: Slow feeding can reduce fines at unchanged burr setting on tested DF64 grinders and speed shot. No universal percentage offset or sensory superiority follows.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js grindGuidance matches feed mode; only unproven 40% prior when better matching history absent

evidence_checks.source: PDF-SLOW-FEED pp5-9
evidence_checks.claim: Do not average raw/normalized grind settings from differing feed modes. Successful recipe ratios from both modes may still provide qualified coffee-level context.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js grindGuidance requires matching feedMode; chooseRecipeFamily ranks matching feed condition but may reuse non-grind ratio

evidence_checks.source: PDF-SLOW-FEED pp1,4,9-10
evidence_checks.claim: Proposals for grinder step size, advanced feed profiles and optional feed duration are historical research suggestions.
evidence_checks.locked: Master Spec 13.5 Oct28 explicitly rejects stepped/stepless control, tick-size feature and new grinder schema; Oct26 retires equipment version-management UI

evidence_checks.source: https://kaffeemacher.de/en/blogs/kaffeewissen/slow-feeding
evidence_checks.claim: Apas baseline x50 250um/fines 33.0%; manual slow-feed same setting 299um/23.9%; experiment on DF64 with differences across coffee/feed method.

evidence_checks.source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-024-55831-x
evidence_checks.claim: Increasing added fines reduced puck permeability/flow and lengthened shot time under their controlled experimental conditions.
2026 espresso poroelastic pressure response study appears as published Physics of Fluids paper per June2026 article and DOI; full publisher paper not read.
Dose and beverage yield are independent measured controls; brew ratio, time, EY and TDS are derived observations. EY≈yield×TDS/dose is a mass balance, not a taste rating.
evidence_checks.grade: PHYSICAL_DEFINITION_CORRECT; RESEARCH DERIVED; NO INDEPENDENT FULL-CITATION AUDIT
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/model.js validateShot stores doseG/yieldG/timeS separately and requires five complete taste scales; site/lib/engine.js does not claim measured EY/TDS absent refractometer

evidence_checks.claim: Grind affects particle area and hydraulic resistance; over-fine may worsen evenness. Pressure/flow are machine-regime-dependent. No universal 9bar, 1:2, 25-30seconds, ideal EY, WDT or prep ranking supports sensory prescriptions.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js nextAdvice uses taste and style-/setup-dependent time as a conditional cue, not a standalone success veto; five active styles; existing dose, grinder calibration and feed-mode gates

evidence_checks.source: ORG-07 203-245, 246-408; external https://research-information.bris.ac.uk/en/publications/a-model-for-the-permeability-of-coffee-pucks-validated-using-x-ra/ ; https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21528 ; https://phys.org/news/2026-06-espresso-pucks-pressures.html
evidence_checks.claim: Wadsworth 2026 peer-reviewed university abstract supports connected pore volume/specific-surface model validated on two roasted coffees and 11 grinds. Waszkiewicz 2026 abstract supports nonlinear pressure-flow and dissolution, but no uniform sensory optima. External abstracts alone do not establish every numeric figure or causal sentence in original #07.
evidence_checks.current_app: App lacks pressure/flow/PSD/refractometer readings and owner-retired advanced hardware versioning. Resist adding unsupported new onboarding fields and profile heuristics.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-05 full 1-298, especially 3-29, 82-101, 220-298; manufacturer https://decentespresso.com/profile_guide
evidence_checks.claim: Nine profile archetypes are overlapping mechanisms (ratio, saturation, pressure and flow), not nine independent app styles. Some require programmable pressure/flow and extra sensors.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/constants.js blob 72221331ce4dffabe416eebec1ae2fceced3a095: STYLES exactly Traditional/Turbo/Fast-Flow/Ristretto/Lungo; Custom retired. Master Specification Oct26 retirement and section S additional families explicitly defer extensions.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-05 82-101,102-141,222-298; https://decentespresso.com/profile_guide and https://decentespresso.com/docs/all_about_blooming_espresso
evidence_checks.claim: Research Allonge refers to high-flow, very long ratio ~1:5 with pressure/flow-managed setup; this is not interchangeable with every longer-ratio Lungo. Turbo, blooming and declining/lever pressure are orthogonal hydraulic strategies.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/constants.js Lungo 1:2.5-3.2 and Turbo/Fast-Flow separate 1:2.2-3.0 / 1:2.35; site/lib/engine.js chooseRecipeFamily restricts same style/coffee and evidence tiers, supports distinct ratio family successes.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-05 29-66,142-181,220-298; publisher https://doi.org/10.1016/j.matt.2019.12.019 ; manufacturer https://lamarzoccousa.com/commercial-products/espresso-machines/strada-ep/
evidence_checks.claim: Cameron et al. experimental peak in extraction yield across grind settings challenges monotonic finer-is-better; specialized 6bar/15g/40g fast shot and programmable pressure examples are bounded implementations. None proves a universal recipe nor a sweetness actuator.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js baseline uses style/roast priors as starting point only, avoids unconditional time success gate, changes one variable with taste; measured pressure/flow/EY/TDS absent. Existing R455-DEC-001 remains unapproved.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-04 lines 1-113,321-352,456-486; Waszkiewicz et al. original HTML https://arxiv.org/html/2512.21528 (v2 May 9 2026, esp methods/results Fig 5); AIP June 23 2026 https://e3.eurekalert.org/news-releases/1132631 and DOI 10.1063/5.0319611
evidence_checks.claim: Puck compression/porosity can make pressure-flow nonmonotonic; one 18.50+-0.05g, 58mm, 1-12bar experimental system had highest measured flow around 5bar, 5-10s wetting. This is a descriptive sample-specific mechanism, not an ideal brewing pressure, no claim pressure universally reduces flow.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js taste-triggered one-variable guidance and 5-style roast priors do not set or measure puck pressure/flow. site/lib/model.js active setup captures machine name, basket nominal dose, optional temperature and slow-feed, not true puck pressure/flow.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-04 lines 2-76,133-320,390-407,476-540; Lelit official https://www.lelit.com/product/bianca-pl162t/ ; Decent official https://decentespresso.com/docs/how_the_de1_measures ; La Marzocco official https://www.lamarzoccousa.com/about-us/history/
evidence_checks.claim: Machine label conflates different causal axes: E61 group hydraulics, saturated thermal group, spring/direct actuator, manual passive upstream restriction and electronically controlled pressure/flow. Vendor product and historical engineering pages verify capabilities but manufacturer sensory benefits are not independent trials.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/model.js stores descriptive machine name and per-setup nominal basket dose with optional temperature/feed mode; no pressure-sensor protocol or user-adjustable hydraulic profiles. Existing app has exactly 5 selectable shot styles (site/lib/constants.js).
evidence_checks.result: NO NEW ADVANCED PRESSURE/FLOW FIELD, SENSOR DEPENDENCY, MACHINE-TYPE INFERRED CONTROL, OR STYLE EXPANSION; NOT OWNER APPROVED

evidence_checks.source: ORG-04 lines 22-51,265-350,476-586; geometric first-order Darcy analysis; author original manuscript methods https://arxiv.org/html/2512.21528
evidence_checks.claim: Basket diameter/bed depth and perforation resistance change hydraulic operating point; table ratio L/A is idealized geometry assuming constant packed density/dose/permeability. Claims that shallow baskets channel less, high-flow baskets always increase EY, or lever pressure yields sweetness are hypotheses, not directly established across machines or coffees.
evidence_checks.current_app: App logs nominal basket dose/ID and does not assume precise bore geometry or pressure drop. Recommendation engine uses same style/setup/basket/feed and personal history rather than a universal cross-basket conversion.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-04 lines 353-475, especially 408-457; existing R455-DEC-001
evidence_checks.claim: Measured TDS is concentration; inferred EY requires measurement. Sweetness, bitterness and crema cannot be reduced to fixed acid/sugar/bitter extraction time stages. No direct source evidence verifies +1g beverage-yield as universal remedy for sweetness-only 4/5 rating.
evidence_checks.current_app: Existing sweetness-only default +1g suggestion remains unchanged in site/lib/engine.js. Current owner product choice R455-DEC-001 awaits approval; five taste scales still required and all-green remains success.

evidence_checks.claim: Equal measured roast degree does not guarantee equal intrabean porosity under different roast time-temperature histories. Precise 0.528/0.474 porosity and 622/747 density cited in original #03 could not be independently checked against accessible original full text. Intrabean porosity is not packed puck permeability.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/constants.js seven-tier roast taxonomy; site/lib/engine.js baseline uses roast as cautious starting heuristic, never direct porosity measure.

evidence_checks.claim: Whole bean gas loss changes with storage age, roast degree and roast speed; gas-mediated controlled espresso pressure/flow outcomes remain weakly identified. No universal age/rest-day grinder conversion follows.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/model.js stores coffee provenance but retired bag feature is not an active roast-age control; site/lib/engine.js does not assign generic rest days.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-03 11,77-83,200-225,275-291; Uman et al 2016 full article https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4834475/
evidence_checks.claim: Experimental bean temperature near -200 C reduced modal PSD about 31% for one tested coffee/grinder; not a universal grinder adjustment, origin/processing effect or taste improvement.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js grinder settings bounded by real equipment/calibration/feed and personal history.

evidence_checks.claim: Origin/elevation/process/variety and decaf method are several causal steps upstream of packed puck physics. Supercritical CO2 decaf changed composition and roast L* behavior, not a proven universal espresso hydraulic correction.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js personalSimilarCoffeeReference uses origin/process/variety only as small unvalidated similarity weights behind successful setup/style/coffee evidence.

evidence_checks.claim: Coffee tasting-note descriptors are downstream labels, not physically causal features. Members' explicit sensory preferences for style selection are a different concept and remain allowed as a subjective preference.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js readPreference reads member preferences (not roaster tastingNotes), chooses optional style; source-derived coffee notes not used as intrinsic grind coefficient.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-02 lines 5-13,85-108,292-299; Mo et al. 2023 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-023-42380-y and Lee/Smith/Arshad https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.12373
evidence_checks.claim: Puck permeability, compression and spatial extraction heterogeneity couple flow to dose, grind and pressure. Mo measured microstructure and simulated SPH; Lee models two idealized flow paths. Neither yields a universal app-specific numeric bar pressure, grind-size transfer, or deterministic WDT percentage.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js recommendation chooses controls from member settings, style and same-coffee evidence; site/lib/constants.js starting style priors; no measured in-puck permeability or pressure profile sensor.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-02 lines 14-20,109-129,171-210; Schmieder et al. Foods 2023 https://doi.org/10.3390/foods12152871
evidence_checks.claim: Controlled 10-fraction espresso measurements found flow rate the largest tested process-variable effect on caffeine, trigonelline, 5-CQA and TDS, while beverage mass/brew ratio changes dominated effects. Experimental composition is not direct evidence that one numeric ratio tastes best.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/constants.js RATIOS are starting priors; site/lib/engine.js uses measured yield and five taste scores; no fixed quality pass/fail clock.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-02 lines 12-19,139-155,171-187,215-229,242-255; Smrke et al. 2024 full published original https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10920694/
evidence_checks.claim: Adding <100 micrometre fines to 20g Costa Rica coffee, 40g beverage at 9bar reduced permeability and increased time; the fastest <10–15s shots reached ~17–18% EY in that experiment. One Q-grader's nonblind 3-attribute subjective evaluation preferred around 30s and 19–20% EY. Efficient turbo extraction does not establish superior taste or universal time thresholds.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/constants.js keeps Traditional, Turbo and Fast-Flow separate; site/lib/engine.js all-green success overrides time prior; taste rating remains user-specific.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-02 lines 236-290 Reddit WDT/flat-vs-conical/beginner temperature and bottomless-basket anecdotes, 282-316 source map; original sources linked within report; no new original direct Reddit audit this run
evidence_checks.claim: Qualitative Reddit observations are nonrandom, uncontrolled, often confounded by simultaneous grinder and technique changes; recurrence does not establish comparative prevalence or causal equipment-brand/98-mm effect. Community advice can generate hypotheses and troubleshooting but not numeric taste-effect guarantees.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js qualitative evenness check on severe astringency/low clarity; personal actual shot feedback takes precedence.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-08 lines 4-13,31-54,56-69; Moroney et al. 2019 original https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0219906 methods and introduction
evidence_checks.claim: Moroney's experiment used 60g coffee, ~1L water at 250mL/min in espresso-shaped apparatus; authors explicitly caution brew quantities/time resemble drip. Historical 18-22% sensory range originates with filter-coffee controls, not demonstrated universal espresso preference.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/constants.js RATIOS/TIMES are labeled initial priors, not sensory gates; site/lib/engine.js checks all five member ratings before preference guidance.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-08 lines 4-13,31-54,61-94; Waszkiewicz et al. 2026 original author v2 https://arxiv.org/html/2512.21528 methods and X-ray experiments
evidence_checks.claim: Observed nonlinear pressure-flow in a specific 18.5g conventional espresso setup and 75-second 8bar followed by repeated pauses/backflow; minimal poroelastic and channeling explanations remain model/interpretation. Does not demonstrate a universal 5bar/9bar taste optimum or general prohibition on bloom/preinfusion.
evidence_checks.current_app: Five locked shot styles maintained, no universal pressure-target setting or prohibition on profile pauses in site/lib/engine.js.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-08 lines 40-53,64-68,74-80,99-138; Mendez Harper/Hendon author preprint https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03103 (full HTML available)
evidence_checks.claim: Pregrind water reduced charge/retention in tested grinders. Dark Temascaltepec EK43/Black Eagle 18g to 45g at 94C and 7bar gained about 16% TDS/concentration in a controlled comparison; light roast had no significant brewing difference. Concentration is not measured taste preference; no blanket water-dose correction.
evidence_checks.current_app: Engine does not infer higher sweetness or a universal grind/time change from moisture, wetting or RDT; member controls, actual shot and taste ratings remain authoritative.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-08 lines 15-29,31-55,70-138; Lee/Smith/Arshad model https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.12373, Waszkiewicz original and Moroney full PLOS
evidence_checks.claim: Controlled variable used by a paper (20kg tamp, WDT/shaking or 1:2 recipe) cannot be cited as independently tested optimum. Model-based channeling should not be labeled observed, or EY/TDS/time labeled sensory improvement; report proposes evidence type, applicability, claim entailment and source strength fields for a RESEARCH ledger, not approved new member UX/data schema.
evidence_checks.current_app: Current SCALES five taste ratings, complete/all-green gates, diagnostic/one-control advice in engine.js; existing lower-confidence heuristics must be disclosed and not elevated by repetition.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-01 lines 3-31,39-80,81-130,301-322; Barista Hustle original https://www.baristahustle.com/the-espresso-compass/ and https://www.baristahustle.com/lesson/b1-2-01-dose/ (original professional guidance)
evidence_checks.claim: At fixed dose a higher beverage yield ordinarily trades strength for greater extraction; evenness and grind can matter independently. The source's 5-10% yield increments and fixed adjustment hierarchy are professional suggested heuristics, not independently randomized universal espresso sensory targets.
evidence_checks.current_app: constants.js STYLES/STYLE_COPY/RATIOS/TIMES are starting priors; engine.js preserves measured dose/yield and only one controllable adjustment. Do not substitute report CSV percentages for owner-Locked rules.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-01 lines 13-30,40-80,91-130,131-275; BH Espresso Compass https://www.baristahustle.com/the-espresso-compass/; Lee/Smith/Arshad two-path MODEL earlier audited under R455-EV-008-D
evidence_checks.claim: A simultaneously sour/bitter/weak shot can be consistent with uneven extraction. Neither professional experience nor a simplified porous-bed model demonstrates actual channeling in a particular member shot; score combinations are not a diagnostic test with measured sensitivity/specificity.
evidence_checks.current_app: engine.js gives a nonnumeric evenness diagnostic for high dryness or low clarity; does not claim that ratings prove visible channels. Incomplete five ratings correctly abstain.

evidence_checks.source: ORG-01 lines 21-27,82-131,275-319; World Coffee Research original https://worldcoffeeresearch.org/resources/sensory-lexicon
evidence_checks.claim: WCR official Sensory Lexicon identifies 110 flavor/aroma/texture attributes; v2 published Oct 2017 explicitly added Sour, Bitter, Salty reference terms. Their standardization does not certify that the report's Hollow/Muted/Finish labels have unique hydraulic causes, or that app five ideal scales are measured clinical/scientific optima.
evidence_checks.current_app: Locked SCALES exactly five extraction/body/clarity/sweetness/astringency; do not rename or expand fields, infer chemical extraction percentage, or change all-green target from research.
